units.source_text: 薰中纳言照例隔着帷屏坐在大女公子病榻近旁。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, sat as usual near the sickbed of the elder princess, separated from her by a curtain screen.

units.source_text: 一阵风来，把帷屏上的垂布吹起。

en.t: A gust of wind came and lifted the hanging cloth of the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 二女公子就退避到里面。

en.t: The younger princess at once withdrew farther inside.

units.source_text: 几个面貌丑陋的侍女也都躲开了。

en.t: Several unattractive-looking serving women also moved out of sight.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言膝行至大女公子近旁，啼啼哭哭地说：“小姐今天病状如何？

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, edged forward on his knees to the elder princess and said through his tears, "How is your illness today, my lady?

units.source_text: 我已竭尽心力，举办了种种祈祷，岂知都是枉然，连你的声音也听不到，真使我大失所望！

en.t: I have exhausted every effort and arranged all kinds of prayers, yet they have all been in vain; I cannot even hear your voice, and it grieves me deeply.

units.source_text: 万一小姐舍我而去，教我何等伤心啊！”

en.t: If you should leave me behind, my lady, how heartbroken I would be!"

units.source_text: 大女公子似已进入失却知觉的状态，然而还能举袖遮面，断断续续地答道：“等我病稍好些，当再与你谈话。

en.t: The elder princess seemed almost unconscious, but she could still raise her sleeve to cover her face and answered haltingly, "When I am a little better, I will speak with you again.

units.source_text: 此刻我只觉得昏沉欲绝，真可恨啊！”

en.t: Just now I feel so dazed that I could almost die; how bitterly frustrating it is!"

units.source_text: 薰中纳言的眼泪更加难于止住了。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, found his tears still harder to hold back.

units.source_text: 忽念哭泣是不祥的，便努力忍耐，不欲被人看见。

en.t: Suddenly remembering that weeping was an ill omen, he struggled to restrain himself and did not want anyone to see him.

units.source_text: 然而终于情不自禁地哭出声来。

en.t: Yet in the end he could not control himself and broke into audible sobs.

units.source_text: 他想：“我对她不知前世有何孽缘，因而热烈地恋慕，终于受尽了苦难而诀别？

en.t: He thought, "What ill-fated bond from a previous life ties me to her, making me love her so passionately only to suffer so much and part from her at last?

units.source_text: 如果此人稍有缺陷，也可使我容易忘情。”

en.t: If only she had even the slightest flaw, it might be easier for me to forget my feelings."

units.source_text: 他就向病人注目细看，但见她的容姿越发端庄优雅、可怜可爱了。

en.t: He then gazed closely at the sick woman and saw that her appearance had become even more dignified, graceful, pitiable, and lovely.

units.source_text: 她的手腕已很瘦细，身体虚弱几同人影。

en.t: Her wrists had grown very thin, and her body was so frail that she seemed almost like a shadow.

units.source_text: 然而艳色曾不少衰，肌肤白嫩如昔。

en.t: Yet none of her beauty had faded, and her skin remained as fair and tender as before.

units.source_text: 穿着柔软的白色衣衫，推开绣被而横卧着的姿态，竟像一个身体扁平的偶人。

en.t: In her soft white robe, lying on her side with the embroidered quilt pushed away, she looked almost like a flat-bodied doll.

units.source_text: 头发并不太密，然而堆积在枕畔，光艳可鉴，美丽之极。

en.t: Her hair was not especially thick, yet it lay piled beside her pillow, lustrous enough to reflect light and beautiful beyond measure.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言看了想道：“不知结局如何！

en.t: Seeing this, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, thought, "How will this end?

units.source_text: 难道已无生望，不可挽救了么？”

en.t: Can it be that there is no longer any hope of life, and that she cannot be saved?"

units.source_text: 便觉无限惋惜。

en.t: He was filled with boundless sorrow and regret.

units.source_text: 她卧病多时，许久不施膏沐，但其姿态比用心打扮、尽心修饰而装模作样的女人优美得多。

en.t: She had been ill in bed for a long time and had not dressed or groomed herself for ages, yet her bearing was far more beautiful than that of women who carefully adorn themselves and pose affectedly.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言仔细端详了一会，神魂飘荡起来，说道：“你倘舍我而去，我一刻也不想留在这世间了。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, studied her intently for a while, his spirit drifting away, and said, "If you leave me, I will not want to remain in this world even for a moment.

units.source_text: 如果命运注定，强要我留在世间，我一定遁迹深山，与世长遗。

en.t: If fate decrees that I must remain alive, I will surely hide myself deep in the mountains and abandon the world forever.

units.source_text: 所不放心者，只有孤苦伶仃地独留在世间的令妹。”

en.t: The only one I cannot help worrying about is your younger sister, left alone and forlorn in this world."

units.source_text: 他想用这话来引出大女公子的答语。

en.t: He hoped that these words would draw an answer from the elder princess.

units.source_text: 大女公子把遮脸的衣袖稍稍揭开，答道：“我身如此薄命，被你视为无情之人，已无可奈何了。

en.t: The elder princess slightly lifted the sleeve that covered her face and replied, "Since I am so ill-fated, there is nothing I can do if you think me heartless.

units.source_text: 只是我曾婉言向你请求：对于我所遗下的妹妹，请你同爱我一样地爱她。

en.t: But I once gently asked you to love the younger sister I leave behind just as you have loved me.

units.source_text: 当时你倘不违背我意，如今我死也瞑目了。

en.t: If you had not gone against my wish then, I could now close my eyes in death in peace.

units.source_text: 我只为有这一点挂念，故对这世间不免留恋耳。”

en.t: Only because of this one lingering concern do I still feel some attachment to this world."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言答道：“我身也如此命苦么！

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, answered, "Is my own fate so wretched too?

units.source_text: 我因除你之外，决不能爱第二个人，故不曾听从你的劝告。

en.t: Because I could never love anyone but you, I did not follow your advice.

units.source_text: 如今思之，不胜后悔，且甚抱歉。

en.t: Thinking of it now, I am overcome with regret and deeply ashamed.

units.source_text: 但令妹之事，务请放心勿念。”

en.t: But as for your younger sister, please be at ease and do not worry."

units.source_text: 他用这话安慰她。

en.t: With these words he comforted her.

units.source_text: 此时大女公子异常痛苦，薰中纳言便召唤做法事的阿阇梨等到病室里来，叫他们施行种种有效的祈祷。

en.t: At this point the elder princess was in extraordinary pain, so Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, summoned the ritual priests and other officiants into the sickroom and had them perform various efficacious prayers.

units.source_text: 他自己也虔诚地求佛。

en.t: He himself also prayed devoutly to the Buddha.
